channelTitle: Most people drink prune juice cold, Grandma June always warms hers first
hook: Most people pour prune juice straight from the fridge, but Grandma June always warms hers first.
remedy: As a classic piece of old-fashioned home wisdom, a small glass of prune juice, warmed rather than ice cold, was sipped in the morning as a gentle way to get things moving when digestion felt sluggish.
steps: Pour a small glass of prune juice, about half a cup to start
Warm it slightly on the stove or in the microwave, just until no longer cold
Sip it slowly on an empty stomach in the morning
caution: Start with a small amount, since too much can cause cramping or loose stools. See a doctor if constipation is severe or lasts more than a few days.
cta: Do you drink your prune juice warm or cold, or do you have another trick that works better? Let Grandma June know.
